extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and store.

extDescription.message: Scan QR codes in any web page image — rendered pixels, distortion-tolerant, multiple codes per image, fully offline.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and store.

actionTitle.message: Scan QR codes in images on this page

contextMenuTitle.description: Native right-click menu item shown on images.

scanButtonTitle.message: Scan QR code in this image
scanButtonTitle.description: Floating scan button tooltip and accessible name.

contentTypeUnknownECI.description: Content type chip: unknown ECI charset.

toastTargetGone.message: The target image is no longer visible. Hover over it again and retry.
toastTargetGone.description: Toast when the hovered image disappeared before scanning.

toastImageTooSmall.message: The image is too small. Zoom in and try again.
toastImageTooSmall.description: Toast when the cropped region is too small to recognize.

toastNotFoundTall.message: No QR code recognized. The image could not be shown in full — scroll it completely into view and try again.
toastNotFoundTall.description: Toast when a tall image could not be fully displayed.

toastNotFound.message: No QR code recognized. If the code is small, zoom in on the image and try again.

toastOpenFailed.description: Toast when opening the link was rejected.

toastNoImageContext.message: No recognizable image found. Right-click directly on an image and try again.
toastNoImageContext.description: Toast when the context-menu entry found no image.

toastNoImageToolbar.message: No recognizable image found. Hover over an image first, then click the extension icon.
toastNoImageToolbar.description: Toast when the toolbar entry found no image.

selectionItemAria.description: Accessible name of a numbered multi-code selection box.

popupAria.description: Accessible name of the result dialog.

closeToast.description: Close button label of the toast.

chipInverted.description: Chip shown when the code was recognized in inverted colors.

popupDomainLabel.description: Prefix before the host name of a recognized link.

openInNewTab.description: Button that opens a recognized http/https link.

copyLink.description: Button that copies a recognized link.

copied.description: Temporary label after a successful copy.

copyFailed.description: Temporary label after a failed copy.

dangerousWarning.message: ⚠ This content uses a dangerous protocol ($SCHEME$); opening has been blocked.
dangerousWarning.description: Warning shown for non-http(s) protocols such as javascript: or data:.

optionsSubtitle.message: All recognition runs locally; the extension makes no network requests.

optMinShortSideName.message: Floating button threshold (visual size, CSS pixels)
optMinShortSideName.description: Options label: minimum rendered short side.

optMinShortSideHint.message: The button appears only when the image's rendered short side in CSS pixels reaches this value; independent of screen zoom and device pixel ratio

unitCssPixels.description: Unit suffix for the threshold input.

optAlwaysShowName.description: Options label: keep the button visible.

optAlwaysShowHint.message: When enabled, the button stays on the most recently hovered image instead of following the pointer

optButtonOpacityName.description: Options label: opacity of the floating button.

optButtonOpacityHint.message: Opacity of the floating button when it is not hovered

optScanModeHint.message: "Thorough" enables tryHarder / rotate / invert / downscale for much better tolerance of distorted codes

optScanLinearHint.message: By default only QR codes are scanned, to avoid false positives

optExpandName.description: Options label: extra pixels around the image.

optExpandHint.message: Extra pixels added around the image to preserve the QR code quiet zone

saveAuto.description: Status text on the options page.

engineInfo.description: Engine version line on the options page.

engineNotReady.description: Engine status when the background worker is unavailable.
